Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 2 of 6; child 4 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Add optional interaction bindings/behaviors to ordinary geoms, scales, guides, facets, and annotations. Mount an SVG widget with direct/nearest hover, plain/structured tooltips, emphasis/inverse emphasis/transitions, typed activation, declarative links, single/multiple selection, and application-controlled state. Cover all built-in logical plot targets.

Acceptance criteria
1. Tooltips support pointer-relative, mark-anchored, and fixed positioning, configurable styling/delay, and focus access; escaped/structured content does not require executable JavaScript strings.
2. Marks, legend keys, colorbar components, facet strips, axes, titles, labels, and annotations expose their typed targets. Every built-in geom/stat has a target/picking coverage entry.
3. A mounted controller provides update, subscribe, and dispose. Repeated mount/update/dispose removes listeners, observers, subscriptions, overlays, indexes, and pending frames.
4. Multiple widgets have isolated state/document IDs; host callbacks receive typed events without querying DOM attributes.
5. Visible focus, keyboard activation/selection, reduced motion, and a navigable text/table companion ship with the first widget; dense plots do not create one tab stop per datum.

Exclusions
Region gestures/navigation, composed linked views, complete browser packaging, and Canvas interaction are separate tasks.

Required evidence
Real-browser pointer/keyboard/lifecycle tests, screenshots at realistic size and tooltip edges, built-in target matrix, and an executable ordinary-plot example.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B19TTCMBEGA2ETW01FG3, bd-01M1Z9B1KDB112GQV9Y7AYF4W1

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 04] Deliver an accessible SVG widget for ordinary plots and plot components
